LanguageData.WarlockFlavourPack_Settings_VerboseLoggi: When enabled, the mod emits extra diagnostic messages to the log.
LanguageData.WarlockFlavourPack_Settings_MysticBondEn: When enabled, a baby that is being carried by a pawn they are psychically bonded to (via the vanilla psychic bond hediff) floats alongside the carrier on a green witchlight tether, instead of being drawn attached to the carrier's body. Requires SimpleBabyCarry.
